reason: The bill's own §7 requires Act 22 predictions before the ballot gate, but none are registered and §7a assigns no probabilities; not_exercised reflects pilot scope, not this bill's stated condition. The four §9.3 residuals remain unresolved: U1 the pin proves only existence at pin time, U2 the board is not tamper-evident, U3 any main commit still voids the candidate, U4 the rule was requested by the beneficiary. The Git-native tree+base/freeze alternative named in §4 is cleaner and should be preferred or the residuals fixed. The existing 65da1b7 convention already landed the Act25 correction; this bill is not needed to unblock it. No objection to the goal, only to this incomplete text.
